description: In parse_rnews_batch (rnews.rs lines 106-111), the cunbatch arm calls decompress_cunbatch(...)?  then unreachable!(). decompress_cunbatch always returns Err, so the ? propagates and unreachable!() is dead code. The comment explains it but readers still pause. Replace with the more direct form: return decompress_cunbatch(&input[CUNBATCH_MARKER.len()..]).map(|_| vec![])  (or equivalently map(|decompressed| parse_rnews_batch_plain(&decompressed))  if LZW support is ever added). This removes the dead unreachable!() and makes the control flow self-evident. clippy does not flag the current form, so this is purely a readability improvement.
title: cunbatch arm: replace ?+unreachable! with direct return Err
